description: Deterministic negative and positive API test generation from OpenAPI 3.x and Swagger 2.0 specs. Ships a CLI and Gradle plugin emitting RestAssured Java/Kotlin tests or JSON/YAML test suites.
rules: Apply the Gradle plugin with id 'art.galushko.openapi-test-generator'; it registers the generateOpenApiTests task and automatically wires template output into test sources and test-suite-writer output into test resources.

The three required inputs are specFile, outputDir, and generator ('template' or 'test-suite-writer'), provided via CLI flags, the openApiTestGenerator Gradle DSL, or a YAML config file (--config-file / configFile).
CLI --setting keys map to testGenerationSettings fields using dot notation for nested maps and [] to append to lists, e.g. --setting 'includeOperations./users/{userId}[]=GET'.
Keys in validSecurityValues must match security scheme names under components.securitySchemes (e.g. ApiKeyAuth), not header names like X-API-Key.
Only negative (4xx) tests are generated by default; set testGenerationSettings.includeValidCase=true to add one baseline positive (2xx) 'Test Valid Case' per operation.
Prefer includeOperations to target specific paths/methods; it filters before generation and is faster than ignoreTestCases name filters, which apply after generation.
CLI flags and Gradle DSL values override YAML config file values; nested maps are deep-merged and lists are replaced.
Path keys in includeOperations and ignoreTestCases match exactly (no globbing); use '*' as the wildcard path or method, and test case names must match exactly.
On BudgetExceededException, raise maxSchemaDepth, maxMergedSchemaDepth, maxSchemaCombinations, or maxTestCasesPerOperation, or exclude the offending operations.

In Gradle, the logLevel property is deprecated and has no effect because the daemon owns the SLF4J binding; run with --info or --debug instead. Artifacts are only written on success unless alwaysWriteTests=true (CLI: --always-write-test).
